#### Important factors: |effects| plot {#sec-pri-626}

[**Purpose**]{#sec-pri-626-effects}

The [|effects| plot](#sec-pri-597) displays the results of a [Yates analysis](#sec-eda-yates-analysis) in both a tabular and a graphical format. It is used to distinguish between important and unimportant effects.

[**Sample |Effects| Plot**]{#sec-pri-626-effectsplot}

```{r}
#| label: fig-pri-626-effects
#| fig-cap: "|Effects| plot for the sonoluminescent light intensity data"
#| fig-width: 9
#| code-fold: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

sono <- read_table(
  here::here("datasets", "INN.DAT"),
  skip = 25,
  col_names = c("y", "x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "x5", "x6", "x7"),
  col_types = "dddddddd"
)

terms <- tribble(
  ~term, ~label,
  "x1", "1",
  "x2", "2",
  "x3", "3",
  "x4", "4",
  "x5", "5",
  "x6", "6",
  "x7", "7",
  "x1x3", "13 (confounded: 27, 46)",
  "x2x3", "23 (confounded: 45, 17)",
  "x1x2", "12 (confounded: 56, 37)",
  "x3x4", "34 (confounded: 16, 25)",
  "x1x4", "14 (confounded: 36, 57)",
  "x1x2x4", "124 (confounded with other 3-factor interactions)",
  "x2x4", "24 (confounded: 35, 67)",
  "x1x5", "15 (confounded: 26, 47)"
)

sono2 <- sono |>
  mutate(
    x1x3 = x1 * x3, x2x3 = x2 * x3, x1x2 = x1 * x2, x3x4 = x3 * x4,
    x1x4 = x1 * x4, x2x4 = x2 * x4, x1x5 = x1 * x5, x1x2x4 = x1 * x2 * x4
  )
model <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7 + x1x3 + x2x3 + x1x2 + x3x4 + x1x4 + x2x4 + x1x5 + x1x2x4, data = sono2)

effects_tbl <- tibble(term = names(coef(model))[-1], effect = 2 * coef(model)[-1]) |>
  left_join(terms, by = "term") |>
  mutate(abs_effect = abs(effect)) |>
  arrange(desc(abs_effect)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rev(label)))

ggplot(effects_tbl, aes(label, abs_effect)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = label, xend = label, y = 0, yend = abs_effect)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Sonoluminescent Light Intensity", subtitle = "|Effects| Plot",
    x = "Term", y = "|Effect|"
  ) +
  theme_light()
```

[**Conclusions from the |effects| plot**]{#sec-pri-626-conclusions}

We can make the following conclusions from the |effects| plot.

1. A ranked list of main effects and interaction terms is:

   - $X_2$
   - $X_7$
   - $X_1 X_3$ (confounded with $X_2 X_7$ and $X_4 X_6$)
   - $X_1$
   - $X_3$
   - $X_2 X_3$ (confounded with $X_4 X_5$ and $X_1 X_7$)
   - $X_1 X_2$ (confounded with $X_3 X_7$ and $X_5 X_6$)
   - $X_3 X_4$ (confounded with $X_1 X_6$ and $X_2 X_5$)
   - $X_1 X_4$ (confounded with $X_3 X_6$ and $X_5 X_7$)
   - $X_6$
   - $X_5$
   - $X_1 X_2 X_4$ (confounded with other 3-factor interactions)
   - $X_4$
   - $X_2 X_4$ (confounded with $X_3 X_5$ and $X_6 X_7$)
   - $X_1 X_5$ (confounded with $X_2 X_6$ and $X_4 X_7$)

2. From the graph, there is a clear dividing line between the first seven effects (all |effect| > 50) and the last eight effects (all |effect| < 20). This suggests we retain the first seven terms as "important" and discard the remaining as "unimportant".
3. Again, the confounding structure reminds us that, for example, the nominal effect size of 70.0125 for $X_1 X_3$ (molarity\*pH) can come from an $X_1 X_3$ interaction, an $X_2 X_7$ (solute\*clamping) interaction, an $X_4 X_6$ (gas\*horn depth) interaction, or any mixture of the three interactions.
